related.description: Most advanced key-value database written in Go, extremely fast, compatible with LSM tree and B+ tree.
Simple key-value store abstraction and implementations for Go (Redis, Consul, etcd, bbolt, BadgerDB, LevelDB, Memcached, DynamoDB, S3, Postg...
LevelDB is a fast key-value storage library written at Google that provides an ordered mapping from string keys to string values.
Distributed transactional key-value database, originally created to complement TiDB
